integrity: The proof uses exact linear-condition and incidence-dimension arguments. Sherratt's divisor, irreducibility, degree 24, and generic finiteness are imported from the cited source; generic uniqueness and rationality are proved here. No numerical experiment substitutes for proof.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns the full projective tensor divisor, not its GIT quotient. The incidence projection is only proved birational, not globally one-to-one or an isomorphism; special tensors can have several rank-at-most-one points or a rank-zero point. A residual literature risk remains for equivalent older tensor-language formulations.
title: Rationality of the rank-one-point divisor for 4-by-3-by-3 tensors
